title: Risk Duplicate Charge and Escalation Review
provenance: Authored for the RefundFlow offline simulation; this text is not copied from external services.
license_notes: Synthetic demo text; not legal advice.
excerpts: Risk review checks for duplicate charges before any refund recommendation reaches the approval queue.
Compare transaction references and timestamps when a second charge appears shortly after the first. Escalate conflicting records for billing review.
A possible duplicate charge is a request for investigation, not proof of fraud and never grounds for an automatic denial.
Record only the minimum case evidence needed for review and remove unnecessary personal information from notes.
